description: Verify an on-chain $FRACTALARENA (BRC-20) transfer and credit it to your balance. Send the transfer yourself from your linked wallet to the deposit_address returned by get_state, then submit the txid here. Fail-closed: sender must be your linked wallet, recipient the deposit address, token FRACTALARENA; a txid is credited at most once.

txid.description: Transaction id (64 hex chars) of the FRACTALARENA transfer to the deposit address.
